objects.name: CutReel
objects.summary: Beat-locked cut vocabulary: base scene with hard pushes and slow drift, pop-in windows, three-up grids, impact hits, all from one frame number and a cut table. Also exports ViewBox, WinFrame, reelAt, StickerDefs.

params.name: cuts
params.note: Cut table sorted by `at` (finished-video frames); kinds: full, win, swap, fill, tri, rot. The first cut must be full.

params.name: f
params.note: Frame of the finished video.

params.name: W
params.note: Width of the scene draw() paints.

params.name: H
params.note: Height of the scene draw() paints.

params.name: draw
params.note: Paints a whole W x H scene for a view.

params.name: camOf
params.type: (view: V, rect: Rect) => { focus: {x, y}, zoom }
params.note: Framing of a view inside a box.

params.name: drift
params.note: Zoom added per frame while holding.

params.name: punch
params.note: Start zoom of an impact hit; decays over 6 frames.

params.name: theme
params.note: Colors and fonts: ink, inkSoft, card, field, fieldInk, rule, ruleSoft, marker, wrong, code, paper, fontBody, fontDisplay, fontMeta. Missing keys use neutral grays and system fonts.

samples.label: Hard push, a pop-in window, then a three-up grid

objects.name: DeckLive
objects.summary: Nine textured cards stacked in depth, seen from the side and turning to face the camera; each card has its own pose so cards can fly in. Canvas can follow the deck or stay full screen with a camera view offset.

params.name: tex
params.note: One texture per layer, index = layer (0 = farthest). Load with useDeckTextures(urls).

params.name: cam
params.note: Orbit camera: azimuth and elevation in degrees, distance in world units. cx / cy = where the deck center lands on the 1920x1080 canvas (camera view offset); setting them keeps the canvas full screen.

params.name: cards
params.note: Per card: k, opacity, edge (0..1), pos [x, y, z], quat. Parent computes these from the current frame.

params.name: cx
params.note: Follow-canvas mode only: canvas is shifted so the deck center lands here.

params.name: cy
params.note: Follow-canvas mode only: same, vertical.

params.name: fullscreen
params.note: Keep the canvas at 0,0 and shift with the camera view offset instead of moving the canvas.

params.name: edgeColor
params.note: Color of the card edge bars.

samples.label: Side view, canvas follows the deck
Full screen with camera view offset

objects.name: Dust
objects.summary: A field of faint specks for dark backgrounds. Same seed, same field, on every render.

params.name: w
params.note: Field width.

params.name: h
params.note: Field height.

params.name: n
params.note: Number of specks.

params.name: rSpan
params.note: Radius is 0.6 + random x rSpan.

params.name: op
params.note: Opacity is op[0] + random x op[1].

params.name: colors
params.note: Two speck colors, picked at random.

params.name: f
params.note: Pass the current frame to make the specks drift. Leave it out for a still field.

objects.name: GLPasses
objects.summary: Generic multi-pass WebGL2 runner: fragment-shader passes in order, a pass can read earlier passes as sampler uniforms, the last pass is drawn to the canvas. No built-in scene.

params.name: passes
params.note: Each: { id?, fs, inputs?: { samplerUniform: passId | textureName }, scale?, float? }. Run in array order; inputs read earlier passes only.

params.name: uniforms
params.note: Float / int ("i" prefix) / vec2-4 by array length; "v3", "v4", "f1" name prefixes force vec3, vec4, float array. Every pass also gets uRes.

params.name: textures
params.note: External textures by name, uploaded before every draw.

samples.label: Two passes: gradient, then a wobbling pixelate of it

objects.name: GlassPrism
objects.summary: Glass triangular prism (transmission material) that can stand up, turn face to face, and flash its edges. Also exports FaceTurn (stick a card on a face), PostFace (line-art post card), faceYaw and PRISM_FACE.

params.name: x
params.note: Canvas center, horizontal.

params.name: y
params.note: Canvas center, vertical.

params.name: size
params.note: Canvas edge, rounded to an integer.

params.name: yaw
params.note: Rotation about the vertical axis. Use faceYaw(k) to face side k to the camera.

params.name: tilt
params.note: Forward tilt.

params.name: view
params.note: 0 = triangular end faces the camera; 1 = standing, a rectangular side faces the camera.

params.name: edges
params.note: "real" draws only the 9 true edges as thin cylinders.

params.name: flash
params.note: Edges go from ink to white; also thickens the edges.

params.name: ink
params.note: Edge color. Parsed by three, so a hex string, not a CSS variable.

samples.label: Standing, a post card on the facing side

objects.name: GrayLines
objects.summary: Placeholder lines that say "there is text here" without asking anyone to read it. Percent widths, or unrolling pixel widths when w is given.

params.name: n
params.note: Number of lines.

params.name: h
params.note: Line height.

params.name: gap
params.note: Space between lines. Default is 14 when w is given.

params.name: seed
params.note: Percent mode only.

params.name: min
params.note: Percent mode only: minimum line width.

params.name: w
params.note: Switches to pixel mode: lines unroll from the left.

params.name: prog
params.note: Pixel mode only: unroll progress.

objects.name: LightBeam
objects.summary: A beam of light (white or one color) that grows from a point, with a soft glow. Also exports LightCone (big soft cone) and SpectrumBand (seven-color band that goes from bundled to fanned out).

params.name: from
params.note: Start point.

params.name: to
params.note: End point.

params.name: w
params.note: Beam width.

params.name: grow
params.note: Fraction grown out from `from`.

params.name: glow
params.note: Outer halo strength.

samples.label: Cone, beam and a fanned spectrum band

objects.name: PlanSheet
objects.summary: Line-art back-office sheet: title bar plus rows of field, value and check. Per-row write / check / highlight / glint progress, driven by the caller.

params.name: rows
params.note: { k, v, write?, check?, hl?, glint? }; the four progress values are 0..1.

params.name: px
params.note: Value font size; everything else scales from it.

params.name: titleIn
params.note: Title opacity.

params.name: theme
params.note: Colors and fonts: ink, inkSoft, card, field, fieldInk, rule, ruleSoft, marker, wrong, code, paper, fontBody, fontDisplay, fontMeta. Missing keys use neutral grays and system fonts.

objects.name: SaturnRise
objects.summary: Eclipse-to-sunrise over a ringed planet: ring of fire at frame 0, camera dive, one light burst as the sun clears the edge, ring-stripe shadows on the planet. Optional real bloom.

params.name: background
params.note: Scene background. Use a dark color with bloom on.

params.name: ringColor
params.note: Color of the ring bands.

params.name: sunColor
params.note: Color of the sun glow sprites.

params.name: bloom
params.note: Add an UnrealBloom post pass (strength 0.9 + burst x 0.9).

objects.name: Seal
objects.summary: A double-ruled stamp: lands oversized, settles in 9 frames, and leaves a ring of ink specks.

params.name: at
params.note: Frame the stamp lands on.

params.name: px
params.note: Font size.

params.name: color
params.note: Border, text and specks.

params.name: pad
params.note: Horizontal padding.

objects.name: SocialPost
objects.summary: Line-art social post card with platform tag, gray avatar, one line of text, media slot and like count. Compact variant when nick is omitted.

params.name: platform
params.note: Platform tag text.

params.name: nick
params.note: Omit for the compact card.

params.name: text
params.note: One line of post text.

params.name: likes
params.note: Like count as shown.

params.name: px
params.note: Body font size; everything else scales from it.

params.name: mediaH
params.note: Media slot height; children are drawn inside it.

params.name: children
params.note: Media content.

params.name: likesK
params.note: Like-count font size = px x likesK.

params.name: theme
params.note: Colors and fonts: ink, inkSoft, card, field, fieldInk, rule, ruleSoft, marker, wrong, code, paper, fontBody, fontDisplay, fontMeta. Missing keys use neutral grays and system fonts.

samples.label: Full post card with a media slot

objects.name: Terminal
objects.summary: Dark terminal window that drops in like paper; monospace lines can type out and get timed underlines. Also exports TermBlock (corner block) and TermRows (placeholder rows).

params.name: x
params.note: Left edge.

params.name: y
params.note: Top edge.

params.name: px
params.note: Code font size.

params.name: title
params.note: Title bar text. Omit for none.

params.name: lines
params.note: { text | parts: [{ t, ul?: { at, dur, linear? } }], dim?, indent?, type?: { at, cps? } }. `at` frames are in the finished video.

params.name: at
params.note: Frame the window appears and drops in.

params.name: tilt
params.note: Start rotation of the drop.

params.name: dropFrames
params.note: Drop duration.

params.name: fg
params.note: Text color of normal lines. Default theme.paper.

params.name: theme
params.note: Colors and fonts: ink, inkSoft, card, field, fieldInk, rule, ruleSoft, marker, wrong, code, paper, fontBody, fontDisplay, fontMeta. Missing keys use neutral grays and system fonts.

samples.label: Terminal with a typed line and timed underlines

objects.name: UrgencyGauge
objects.summary: Vertical cell meter for "how urgent" with a continuous water level and an alert-colored top cell. Also exports Sweat (drop) and cellsLit(level).

params.name: h
params.note: Tube height.

params.name: level
params.note: Water level; the top cell fills by the fractional part.

params.name: peak
params.note: Top cell turns the alert color.

params.name: label
params.note: Label above the tube, sized for one character.

params.name: theme
params.note: Colors and fonts: ink, inkSoft, card, field, fieldInk, rule, ruleSoft, marker, wrong, code, paper, fontBody, fontDisplay, fontMeta. Missing keys use neutral grays and system fonts.

samples.label: Meter at 60% with a sweat drop
